title: Implement API Rate Limiting with Redis
title_es: Implementar Rate Limiting de APIs con Redis
description: Runnable companion for the Redis rate limiting recipe: Lua-atomic token bucket, sliding-window sorted-set limiter, Express middleware with RateLimit headers, and per-tier configuration.
description_es: Companion ejecutable de la receta de rate limiting con Redis: token bucket atómico con Lua, limiter de ventana deslizante con sorted sets, middleware Express con headers RateLimit y configuración por tier.
